items.title: n0n Ransomware: Inside an AI-Assisted Extortion Operation
items.content: In September 2026, an exposed staging server revealed the complete operational workspace of a n0n ransomware operator, including breach tools, encryptor source code, extortion infrastructure, and an AI coding agent environment with over $7,000 in paid LLM API usage. items.title: 68 GB Stolen From a Philippine Government Agency's Overseas-Employment Databases, Exposed by the Operator's Own Open Directory
items.content: An unidentified operator exfiltrated 68.837 GiB of database backups from a Philippine government agency managing overseas employment and migrant workers on 6 September 2026. The theft involved 27 SQL Server backups containing case-management systems including POEA and OFW variants. Targeted industries: Government. Associated malware: Wrqsnx, GodPotato.

items.title: PolinRider Malware Force-Pushed Into AsyncAPI, CircuitVerse and Open Food Facts Pull Requests
items.content: On October 19, 2026, the GitHub account Eternity0207 force-pushed malicious commits containing obfuscated PolinRider malware loaders into open pull requests across AsyncAPI Generator, CircuitVerse, and Open Food Facts.
